aism_behavior: class-driven (no AISM counterpart -- AISM's argument.py has no signature vocabulary, no convention profile, and no regime reasoning of any kind).
notes: An INCONSISTENT interval: `[const, inv-poly]` has its lower endpoint ABOVE its upper one in the `gap` chain, so it names no set of values at all. Classified `signature-malformed` rather than as a regime clash (codex review finding 10) because it is a broken VALUE, not a substantive disagreement -- reporting it as `regime-unentailed` would send the author hunting for a dependency that could satisfy something unsatisfiable by construction. This check needs the profile (the order is profile-defined), which is why it lives with the vocabulary stage and not with the shape parser. The same rule refuses an interval between two INCOMPARABLE endpoints on a poset key -- see test/gates/signature-entail.test.ts.
